subject: Pilot: Access controls + ops runway for HelixSystems SSO/SCIM pilot
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@helixsystems.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@helixsystems.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: Access controls + ops runway for HelixSystems SSO/SCIM pilot

Hi Irene / Redwood team,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier — Helix is excited to move the pilot into a narrower scope so we can validate SSO + SCIM provisioning and an IP-based admin allowlist before a broader rollout. Quick ask to help us sequence deliverables and confirm the operations handoff:

- Can you share a concise playbook for the pilot (roles, service accounts, temporary grants, rollback)?
- Who on your side will be the day-to-day contact for provisioning and post-cutover support?
- We'll need the SCIM attribute mapping for AD -> Redwood profiles (email, displayName, employeeId) so our identity team can prepare.

We are targeting a staging cutover window the week of 5/29 and would like a short ops run-through 48 hours prior.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Director, IT Integrations
HelixSystems

Attachment: helix_requirements_summary.pdf (pdf, 92KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@helixsystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Access controls + ops runway for HelixSystems SSO/SCIM pilot

Hi Maria — great to hear. I pulled together a short pilot playbook and a provisioning checklist (attached) — the plan below is intentionally narrow to validate the end-to-end path:

Pilot scope (summary):
- SSO via SAML (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated sanity checks)
- SCIM: create/update/deactivate for a 25-user pilot group (email, displayName, employeeId)
- Admin IP allowlist for Redwood Console (static /24 from Helix management VPC)
- One service account for automated SCIM sync (scim-sync-helix@redwood.ai)

Operational runway:
- Week of 5/29: staging cutover (target Wed 5/31 10:00-12:00 PT)
- Tue 5/30 10:00 PT: ops dry-run with Helix IT + Redwood oncall (30m)
- Post-cutover 72-hour observation window where elevated support is on-call

Day-to-day contacts:
- Irene Choi / Customer Success (primary) — onboarding, playbook, rollbacks
- Marissa Cole / Implementation Lead — provisioning, SAML metadata, runbook ownership
- Jonas Weber / Security Eng — IP allowlist, service account policies
- Neha Kapoor / Solutions Eng — SCIM attribute mapping and test harness

I've attached: pilot-access-playbook-v1.pdf and scim-provisioning-checklist.docx. Please confirm the cutover window and whether Helix IT needs any pre-approved IP ranges or temporary VPN access.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-access-playbook-v1.pdf (pdf, 210KB); scim-provisioning-checklist.docx (docx, 34KB)

From: Carlos Vega <c.vega@helixsystems.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@helixsystems.com>, procurement@helixsystems.com
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Access controls + ops runway for HelixSystems SSO/SCIM pilot

Thanks Irene — that plan looks good. Two follow-ups from our side:

1) Service accounts & least privilege: our security team requires the service account to use scoped API keys and for provisioning calls to be limited to the pilot org only. Can Jonas advise on the minimal permissions needed for scim-sync-helix?

2) Procurement: we'll need a short SOW addendum referencing the pilot acceptance criteria (create/update/deprovision success rates, SSO session timeouts, and support response times). procurement@helixsystems.com is looped for any contractual addendum.

Also — confirming we want the ops dry-run Tue 5/30 10:00 PT. If that works for Redwood, I'll send calendar invites.

Regards,
Carlos Vega
IT Operations Manager
HelixSystems

Attachment: helix_security_requirements.pdf (pdf, 56KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Vega <c.vega@helixsystems.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@helixsystems.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, procurement@helixsystems.com
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: Access controls + ops runway for HelixSystems SSO/SCIM pilot

Carlos — thanks for the clarifying notes. Quick answers and next steps:

- Jonas, recommended minimal permission set for scim-sync-helix: POST/PUT to /scim/v2/Users on the Helix pilot org only; token rotation every 30 days; audit logs exported to Helix S3 bucket. Jonas will drop a short IAM policy snippet to the Drive link today.

- SOW addendum: Irene and I will draft a 1-page pilot acceptance criteria addendum (targets: 98% provisioning success rate in staging, SSO basic flows succeed for 25 test accounts, support response < 2 hours during observation window). We'll circulate a DocuSign link by Monday and target signature before cutover.

- Ops dry-run: confirmed Tue 5/30 10:00 PT. Redwood invites to follow. Please include your identity team and the person who manages the Helix allowlist firewall so we can validate IP ingress.

Operational notes for cutover day:
- Pre-cutover checklist (30m before): verify SAML metadata exchange, confirm SCIM test users appear in staging, lock admin allowlist to Helix IPs.
- Rollback: revert SCIM provisioning & restore old session policies (we keep a time-limited switch to previous auth config).

I'll follow up with the brief DocuSign and the IAM snippet later today. Looking forward to the dry-run.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: helix-ssomapping.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)
